automationNotes: Doc [**Invite a User to the Project**](https://www.contentstack.com/docs/personalize/user-permissions): App Switcher → **Personalize** → project → **Settings** → **Users** → **+ Invite User** → modal (**Email Addresses**, optional **Message**) → **Invite**. Shares runner targets/handlers with **`manage-personalize-project`** where the UI matches. Email: `step.value` or **`PERSONALIZE_INVITE_EMAIL`** / **`CS_INVITE_TEST_EMAIL`** / **`CS_EMAIL`**. Project card: **`PERSONALIZE_PROJECT_CARD_CONTAINS`** / **`DAL_PERSONALIZE_PROJECT_SEARCH`** (see **`manage-personalize-project`**).
